title: Strand-specific transcription / TSS mapping
description: TEX-enriched RNA coverage in LB at OD600 0.4, biological replicate B2. A 60 kb reference window is summarized on both strands.
processing: Read the two variableStep WIG files from GSM1331413. Group actual reported positions 1–60000 into 200 bp reference intervals. For each interval and strand, retain the arithmetic mean of the absolute reported coverage values and the signed mean. Missing WIG positions are excluded, not imputed as zero. coveredPositions reports the denominator. No transcription start calls or antisense classifications are invented. The separate tssAnnotations array comes directly from DataSetS1, TSS Map MasterTable: LB_0.4, detected=1, Pos<=60000. All source Primary/Secondary/Internal/Antisense flags and gene associations are retained; duplicate positions may have multiple class/gene assignments.

limits: One growth condition, one TEX+ biological sample, a 60 kb subset.
Coverage records and the separate study-predicted TSS annotations are different data types; prediction does not imply functional validation.
Coverage is the mean over positions reported in the WIG, not a full-window zero-filled average.
Opposite-strand coverage does not by itself establish functional antisense regulation.
